title: Evaluating Bioequivalence of a Fixed Dose Combination Versus Tablets of Bempedoic Acid / Ezetimibe and Rosuvastatin

sections.abstract: The recommended first-line treatment of cardiovascular disease is a statin monotherapy; however, combination therapies represent an opportunity for an individualized, patient centered approach to low density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) lowering and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk reduction in patients unable to reach individualized serum LDL-C levels. This study will test the bioequivalence of a test fixed dose combination (FDC) product versus the co-administered individual reference products.
